confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. Hostel and hotel anchors are lower confidence because July is peak summer in Hokkaido and rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine are based on the local relationship to beer, since direct knowledge is weaker. The RBA USD/AUD observation could not be verified from an rba.gov.au page in search, so fx is null and should not be used for conversion until the official rate is confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Japanese regional cities of similar size and tourism profile, such as Sendai, Fukuoka and Hiroshima, adjusted for Sapporo's summer demand premium and its strong beer and food scene. Yen-to-USD conversion assumes roughly 150 JPY per USD.
